tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mdo chog yid bzhin nor bu'i lhan thabs rin chen bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /mdo chog yid bzhin nor bu'i lhan thabs rin chen bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdo chog yid bzhin nor bu'i lhan thabs rin chen bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rlabs chen smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bzang po/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal du legs grub pa/ /bcom ldan sman gyi bla sogs bde gshegs bdun/ /shākya'i tog dang bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ / 'dir sman bla'i cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs pa 'ga' zhig paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa'i sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po bsdus pa ltar nyams su len par 'dod pa la cho ga der don gyi gtso bo rnams tshang yang kha bskang bar 'os pa 'ga' zhig snang ba rnams kyis zur brgyan nas brjod par bya ste/ de yang sbyor ba la/ sku dang mchod pa sogs yod na sta gon bya zhing*/ med na'ang mos pas kyang byar rung la/ sngon du theg pa chen pa'i gso sbyong 'dod na len cing ma byas na'ang lhag chad du mi 'gyur ro/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs spyi ltar ram/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad zhes sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ mos pa shugs drag dang bcas te 'di ltar/ /mchog bden rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag pa'i mthus/ /zhing 'di bde ba can ltar snod bcud kyi/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'dod dgus 'byor gyur cig /rin chen sa gzhi ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan/ /gser dngul mu tig bye ma sbram bur bdal/ /me tog gcal bkram tsandan dri bsung ldang*/ /lha mi'i longs spyod kun bzang mchod pas khyab/ /der ni yid 'ong nor bu'i pho brang dbus/ /padma seng khrir rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /bzhugs nas gzungs ring mos stobs kyis bskrun pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cing*/ / ces pas sa gzhi sogs byin brlab bya/ de nas/ 'dod na rnam dag chos dbyings ma dang*/ ma lus sems can ma lta bu ci rigs kyi 'phror/ snyigs ma'i mgon po brtse ldan bde gshegs bdun/ /thub dbang dam chos byang sems bka' sdod bcas/ /bdag sogs skyob phyir mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du/

/ spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs gdan 'dzom byin brlob mdzod/ /ces pas spyan drangs te/ spro na khyed sku rang bzhin sogs kyis khrus dang sku dbyings gos 'bul rnams kyang byas chog /thung mong du yan lag bdun gyi thog mar phya 'tshal ba ni/ lhar bcas skye rgu ma lta bu rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /shākya'i rgyal po 'jam dbyangs zhi 'tsho sogs/ /zab mo'i mdo 'di phyag mtshan bzhes pa yi/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyams thag 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i thugs rje can/ /bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos/ /'jam dpal skyabs grol gsang bdag tshangs dbang dang*/ / rgyal chen gnod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang*/ yang na/ mkhas btsun chen po sogs dang*/ mtshan legs rin chen sogs dang*/ kun 'byung mun pa'i sa bon sogs dang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang skyabs 'gro la sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas kyang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i yan lag rgyas par na/ me tog dam pa nas/ mchod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu/ dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ /dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bcom ldan gdan 'dzom chen po dgongs su gsol/ /bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dag /shākya'i bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma la/ /'grub par 'gyur ba zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ /bdag la bden pa mngon sum bstan du gsol/ /zhes pas dbang du gsol/ de nas so sor yan lag bdun smon lam bcas byed pa la/ dang po ni dad shugs drag pos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs sgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun dang*/

de bzhin du gzhan bdun la 'gre/ mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la/ dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur ba/ /mtshan legs yongs sgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ chen por bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa bya zhing*/ 'di'ang 'og ma dgu la sbyor/ rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus/ /bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*/ /nad rims gshed byed sdig can gdon las thar/ /dbang po kun tshang sdug bsngal sdig rgyun chad/ /ngan 'gror mi ltung lha mi'i bde ba myong*/ /bkres skom dbul 'phongs zhi zhing 'byor gyur cig /bcings dang brdeg sogs lus kyi gdung ba med/ /stag seng sbrul gyis 'tshe bral 'thab rtsod zhi/ /byams pa'i sems ldan chu yis skrags rnams kyang*/ /dbugs phyin 'jigs med bde bar brgal gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing der padmo las skyes yon tan rdzogs/ /mtshan legs yongs sgrags la sogs rgyal rnams kyi/ bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das nas/ sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang padmas rab tu brgyad pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /rin chen zla ba dang padmas rab brgyad cing*/ /shes bya kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sgra dbyangs rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams nas/ bsngo/ rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus/ / bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*/ /g.yengs rnams chos 'phel lha mi'i tshog chas 'byor/ /btsa' ba'i gdung bral rtag tu skyes par gyur/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral dge chos rgyal/ /sgrib byang lha yi'i bde ba 'thob gyur cig /bshes bral mun par gdon gtses 'chi dang dgra/

/dgon pa'i gnod med mchod dang rim 'gror brtson/ /dman rnams ting 'dzin dran stobs gzungs ldan cing*/ /shes rab mchog thob mes nyen bsil gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing der padmo las skyes yon tan rdzogs/ /sgra dbyangs rgyal po la sogs rgyal rnams kyi/ /bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /gsum pa ni/ bcom ldan nas/ gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba/ /nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ / dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku/ /gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ rgyal ba'i/ nas sems can gang dang gang*/ /tshe thung ring 'tsho dbul rnams dbang phyug tshangs/ /'thab rtsol 'gyed pa'ang byams pa'i sems ldan zhing*/ /bslab bral ngan song mi ltung sdom pas bsdams/ /byang chub sems dang 'bral ba med gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos/ nas/ gser bzang dri med la sogs rgyal rnams kyi/ /zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ nas/ mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /mya ngan 'das zhi bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa/ /'gro ba'i dug gsum sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*/ /'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa yi/ /mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas bsngo/ rgyal ba'i/ nas/ gang dang gang*/ mya ngan sogs zhi mi 'bral tshe ring bde/ /dmyal bar rgyal ba'i 'od kyis bde dga' rgyas/ /mdangs ldan mdzes 'byor 'byung pos mi 'tshe zhing*/ /phan tshun byams ldan nad rnams med gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos/ nas/ mya ngan med mchog sogs sngar bzhin no/ /lnga pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ nas/ chos sgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/

/chos sgra chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' zhing*/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /chos sgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ rgyal ba'i= /bdag cag la= /rtag tu yang dag lta dang dad ldan zhing*/ /chos kyi sgra thos byang chub sems kyis phyug / longs spyod slad du sdig spangs 'byor pa 'phel/ /byams gnas tshe ring chog shes nyid gyur cig /'di nas= /zhing der= /chos sgrags rgya mtsho sogs sngar bzhin no/ /drug pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das nas/ chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ / skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la rol mdzad cing*/ /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po/ /mngon mkhyen rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ /rgyal ba'i nas/ gang dang gang*/ g.yengs rnams gnod sems med cing chog chas 'byor/ /ngan song lam ngan zhugs rnams dge bcu thob/ /gzhan dbang gyur rnams rang dbang phun tshogs shing*/ /kun kyang tshe ring mtshan thos dge gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas/ mngon mkhyen rgyal po sogs sngar bzhin no/ /bdun pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das nas/ sman gyi bla baiḍūryā 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /baiḍūryā'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ rgyal ba'i nas/ sems can gang dang gang*/ /mtshan dpes mdzes shing 'gro kun bdag 'drar gyur/ /'od kyis mun sel shes rab thabs mkhas kyis/ /longs spyod mi zad lam log dman mos rnams/ /theg chen lam zhugs sdom pas mdzes gyur cig /tshul 'chal gdung bral dbang po kun tshang zhing*/

/nad med yo byad 'phel zhing bud med kyi/ / dngos pos skyo rnams rtag tu skyes dbang ldan/ /bdud zhags lta ba ngan las grol gyur cig /rgyal pos mnar rnams bde zhing bkres pa'i rgyus/ /sdig pas 'tsho rnams chos 'byor zas kyis tshim/ /tsha drang ngal zhi bsam pa yongs rdzogs shing*/ /'phags pa dgyais pa'i tshul ldan grol gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas/ sman pa'i rgyal po sogs sngar bzhin no/ /brgyad pa ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das nas/ dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*/ /gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ / gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bshams nas/ bsngo/ /ston pa mchog des mdo sde'i cho ga las/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i phan yon ma lus pa/ /bdag cag mgon med 'gro ba mtha' dag gis/ /deng 'dir phral du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgu pa ni/ ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog /sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul/ /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi/ /'di man lan bdun nam gsum ci rigs bya/ kun 'byung mun pa'i sa bon/ sogs kyi mthar/ dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ /dam chos dkon mchog bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /bcu pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang skyabs grol dang phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pas mdo sde dbang po gsungs pa'i tshe/ /phan yon cho ga ji ltar bya ba sogs/ /gsal mdzad rgyal sras 'jam dpal skyabs grol dang*/ gsang bdag 'khor bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ /'jam dpal skyabs grol phyag na rdo rje sogs/

/bde gshegs sras po sum khri drug stong gis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskul zhing gleng bslangs nas/ /mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad gsungs pa rnams deng 'dir bdag la mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang gnod byin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ / so sor dbye bar 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ yangs pa can du bde gshegs gdan 'dzom tshe/ /bstan dang mdo sde 'dzin par byed pa gang*/ /srung bar zhal bzhes 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang gnod sbyin gyi sde chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la bdag gis mchod pa'i tshogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /gtor ma yod na/ khyad par du yang mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing*/ bdag sogs la bde skyid rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /'jig rten skyong ba sde dpon bcas pas kyang*/ /sngon tshe ston pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin/ /dgra dang gnod pa nad rims bzlog pa dang*/ /'thab rtsod kun zhi lus sems bde ba rgyas/ / longs spyod dbang phyug nor 'bru tshe 'phel zhing*/ /bsams pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /rtag tu bsrung skyob g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /gzhi bdag gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na spyi ltar phul chog /de nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dzyai gu ru baiḍūryā pra bha rwa dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te saṃ mya ka saṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzyai bhai ṣa dzye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dzyai bhai ṣa dzye/ rā dza sa mudga te swā hā/ ces gzugs ring nas/ yang na/ tadya thā/ bhai ṣa dzyai sogs gzungs thung dang*/

ghu me ghu me sogs kyang bzla'o/ /gzungs bum bsgrubs kyang mi 'gal la/ gser bzang dang phyag rdor gyi gzungs sogs bzlas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /mjug tu bstod phyag rgyas par sbyor ba'am/ /bsdu na/ mkha' khyab zhing gi sogs sam/ bka' drin mnyam med sogs bla ma dang*/ nyam thag 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i thugs rje can/ /zhes sogs gnyis kyi mjug tu/ dngos bshams/ nas/ bsngo/ /yang na/ ji snyed su dag nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis de rnams byas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs saṃ/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis gshegs gsol dang*/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs dang*/ snyigs ma'i 'gro la sogs pa ci rigs kyis bsngo smon bkra shis kyang bya'o/ /rjod byed tshig gi spros bral yang*/ /mdo chog don gyi snying po kun/ /brjod byar ma tshang med 'dus pa/ /'di ko rin chen bum bzang bzhin/ /ces mdo chog yid bzhin nor bu'i lhan thabs rin chen bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ gnas brtan grags pa dpal 'byor la sogs pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gis bskul bas rkyen byas te paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi dgongs pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // ༈ na mo sapta ta thā ga tā ye/ sman bla'i mdo dang de'i cho ga rgyas pa nas 'byung ba'i smon lam rnams zung du bkol nas rang gzhan gyi don du kha ton byas na 'jug pa bde zhing*/ sman bla'i mdo'i don gyi snying po yang nyams su blang bar 'gyur bas phan yon kyang che bar mthong nas/ sa bzhi byin rlabs sogs kyi steng du yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa byas rjes/ smon lam rnams phyogs gcig tu 'don tshul dngos su ma bkod par gzhan du kha 'phangs pa'i sgo nas brjod na/

skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas 'di ltar/ mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings bden stobs kyis/ /snod bcud mchod tshogs sbyar ba 'di kun kyang*/ /bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa ltar gyur cig /mdun gyi nam mkha' gzhal med khang chen dbus/ / rin chen seng khrir pad zla'i gdan la sogs/ /bde gshegs rnams dang byang sems chos skyong ba'i/ /bzhugs gnas phun tshogs mdzes par grub gyur cig /shar phyogs gang gā'i bye snyed 'das pa yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing nas bde gshegs mched bdun dang*/ /thub dbang byang sems nyan rang bka' sdod bcas/ /brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs bzhugs su gsol/ /'dod na gshegs byon skye 'bri med pa'i sku/ /sogs kyis spyan 'dren dang*/ khyed sku rang bzhin sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang sogs kyis khrus/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku byi/ srab 'jam sogs kyis gos/ sa gzhi spos kyi 'am/ bdag gzhan lus ngag sogs kyis maṇḍal 'bul zhing*/ bstod phyag rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ mkhan chen zhi 'tsho la sogs bla ma dang*/ bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos/ 'jam dpal skyabs grol gsang bdag tshangs dbang dang*/ rgya chen gnod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang*/ mkha' khyab zhing gi sogs phyag bya/ de nas bde gshegs rnams la phyag mchod phyogs gcig tu byed pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nas sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes so so nas lan bdun re/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang dam pa'i chos rnams dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/

/mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /mchod pa'i tshogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i phung po ci bgyis pa rnams so sor bshags so/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba kun kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /yang na 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag la mchod yon dang sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ der rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa dang phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis nas 'jigs pa med par rgal bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis mtshan legs dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag zhing las kyi las nas dngos po thob par gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis sgra dbyangs dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag srog gcod pa nas dgongs par gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis gser bzang dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag mya ngan dang nas yongs su thar bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis mya ngan med pa dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag log par lta ba can nas cho ga shes par gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis chos sgrags rgya mtsho dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag zhing las dang nas bde ba myong bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis chos rgya mtsho dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po nas bde ba la gnas par gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis sman bla'i smon lam rnams brjod nas mthar thun mong du/
